title: Replace hardcoded three_in_line with composable CEL functions
description: three_in_line is a game-specific predicate baked into both engines. It should be decomposed into composable CEL primitives from the standard function library (DESIGN.md lines 348-368): zone(), in_line(), count(), connected(). The end condition for tic-tac-toe would become something like exists(lines(zone('board'), current_player), line, size(line) == width) — general enough for any n-in-a-row game. Same treatment needed for all_cells_occupied (trivially: count(zone('board'), empty) == 0). Requires the CEL function library to be implemented first.
close_reason: Grid serialized as lines/rows/cols/diags of owner strings. Tic-tac-toe uses lines.exists(line, line.all(cell, cell == current_player)). Python evaluator supports .exists()/.all() macros. 6 new tests.
